accepted.response:
Looking at the P-labels, I can find merge candidates:

- op 1 (ZIII) and op 15 (ZIII): same P, nothing non-commuting with ZIII of the opposite parity in between that blocks it... need to check commutation of everything between them. But let's check the easier ones first.
- op 12 (IIZI), op 19 (IIZI), op 39 (IIZI): all same P=+IIZI, candidates to merge.
- op 0 (IIIZ) and op 30 (IIIZ): same P.
- op 22 (IIIX) and op 28 (ZIIX): different P, no merge.

**op 12, op 19, op 39 merge (P=+IIZI):** Need everything between each pair to commute with IIZI (i.e. have even overlap with Z on q2, or be identity on q2). Between op12 and op19: op15(ZIII, overlap 0 qubits with q2 →commutes - differ on 0 qubits... wait rule: commute iff differ on even # qubits *where both nonidentity*. ZIII vs IIZI: only q0 differs, q2 identity for ZIII - overlap qubits where both non-I: none → commute (0 is even). h/cx are Clifford conjugation already absorbed into P calc. So op15 commutes. Between op19 and op39: ops 20,22,28,30 (q3 stuff, IIIZ/IIIX/ZIIX/ZIIZ) — overlap with IIZI is 0 qubits (q2 identity in all) → commute. op32,34,36 (IIZZ,ZIZZ,ZIZI) overlap on q2: IIZZ vs IIZI differ at q2(both Z)+q3(Z vs I)= only q2 both nonI →1 qubit overlap→odd→does NOT commute! So op39 can't merge with op19 across op32/34/36.

So only merge op12 and op19 (adjacent-ish, only op15 ZIII between them, commutes). Fix op19 -> 0, refit op12 to absorb: combined angle for op12 should become (angle12 ± angle19). Signs are both +IIZI (same sign) so angles add: -0.7279362058 + 1.611480107 = 0.883543901, not near pi/4 multiple — still needs synthesis, no T savings alone. But this removes one rotation from synthesis list (op19), saving ~1 T-slot (58T) at cost of possibly adjusting op12 (no cost change, still 1 rotation). Net: -58T, -1 rotation synthesized.

```fix
op 19 -> 0
```
